audience.role: A DSH user deciding whether to install or upgrade, and a first-time repository reader

checks.note: Each README owns installation, activation, compatibility, and operating guidance; each changelog records the version delta and evidence boundary without duplicating the full user path.

A reader can identify 0.5.2 as the release, install it, check the host-lock JSON verdict, restart DSH, enable Guard, and distinguish the exact rc.2-or-rc.1 support union from complete graph acceptance.
The useful install and status actions appear before host-lock and cohort details; the documents explain the complete 33-package graph and fail-closed result where those terms first affect a decision.
The text limits compatibility claims to the exact rc.2 and rc.1 host releases and separates package discovery, graph identity, CI, native acceptance, publication, and live market refresh.
Both language paths lead with installation and the observable supported verdict, then explain compatibility mechanics and evidence; the changelogs lead with the market-visible metadata correction.

English and Chinese were read independently. Each includes the same version, command, support union, graph boundary, restart requirement, and evidence limitations without depending on the other edition.

limitations: Cold read covers both complete README entry paths and the current 0.5.2 changelog entries; unchanged historical changelog entries were not re-reviewed end to end.
The receipt binds current document bytes and does not establish source tests, CI, native acceptance, publication, or market refresh. Any listed-document edit requires a new cold read.
